messages:
Samir Patel: got a page for hosted-inference (us-east-1) — sudden spike in 502s starting ~12:34 UTC. I'm investigating. will post updates here.

IncidentBot: PagerDuty alert triggered: hosted-inference-502-rate (priority: P2) — 502 rate > 1% over 5m in us-east-1. Alert details: https://monitoring/redwood/alerts/6721

Maria Gonzales: on it. checking service logs and proxy metrics. not seeing host CPU/GPU utilization climb, but backend queue depth for model-pool-a is spiking.

Alex Kim: interesting — i just saw an influx of long-running requests to the llama-13b-v1 variant. maybe a bad prompt loop. i can divert traffic to model-pool-b (fallback) for a short window. initiating routing change now.

Samir Patel: do the routing diversion, Alex. also thinking we should silence noisy alerts while we stabilize so oncalls don't get flooded. we still need visibility though.

Eva Liu: i can add a short silence in Alertmanager. proposing 30m on rule hosted-inference-502-rate scoped to us-east-1. annotate with "post-incident: temp silence while routing/fix". want me to proceed?

Maria Gonzales: +1 from me. silence will stop duplicates while we confirm root cause. I'll keep watch on dashboard and metrics.

Eva Liu: creating silence...

IncidentBot: Alertmanager silence created by Eva Liu (30m) — silence_id: s-20260315-1 — scope: hosted-inference.us-east-1.

Alex Kim: routing change deployed — 75% traffic -> pool-b, 25% -> pool-a. 502s already dropping. pre-change 502 ~9% -> current ~0.8%.

Samir Patel: great. leaving the silence for now. quick note on thresholds: our alert fires at >1% over 5m. that felt too aggressive for short transient traffic shifts. we should discuss changing to >2% or >1.5% and maybe extend window.

Maria Gonzales: agreed. for production traffic patterns a 1% threshold catches small bursts that are self-healing. proposing: change rule to "502 rate > 2% over 5m OR >1% over 15m". also add a minimum request volume check (only fire if total_rps > 100).

Alex Kim: sounds reasonable. also want a dashboard panel that shows per-model-pool queue depth + per-replica accepted vs queued. i'll add a grafana panel and link it in the runbook.

Samir Patel: can you paste the alert rule snippet you propose and the grafana panel JSON so we can review?

Alex Kim: sure — snippet below:

```yaml
# proposed alert rule (Prometheus)
- alert: HostedInferenceHigh502Rate
  expr: |
    (sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="hosted-inference",status_class="5xx"}[5m]))
      / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="hosted-inference"}[5m]))) > 0.02
    and sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="hosted-inference"}[5m])) > 100
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    summary: "Hosted inference 5xx rate high in {{ $labels.region }}"
```

```json
// grafana panel snippet (queue depth)
{"type":"timeseries","title":"Model-pool queue depth (per pool)","targets":[{"expr":"sum(queue_depth{pool=~\"pool-.*\"}) by (pool)","format":"time_series"}],"gridPos":{"h":8,"w":12}}
```

Maria Gonzales: makes sense. i'll test the rule locally against last 30 days of metrics to make sure we don't blind ourselves. will run query and send false-positive rate.

Eva Liu: operational note: i'll add a maintenance-window template for planned scaling events that automatically applies a scoped silence and adds an annotation. reduces ad-hoc silences.

Samir Patel: can we also add an automated check that when routing changes are made (rollback/divert) we annotate the alert with the routing change id? that'll help correlate.

Alex Kim: yes — deploy-bot can add annotations. i'll wire it to include routing.change.id in the deployment metadata. DeployBot, can you confirm?

DeployBot: will do. will append routing.change.id and canary_percent to the active incidents when routing config is changed.

Maria Gonzales: quick customer impact check: CS queue shows 2 tickets referencing timeouts in that window but both appear internal (dev keys). no major customer-facing errors logged. i'll keep monitoring.

Samir Patel: good — low customer impact. action items recorded: 1) update alert rule to proposed expression (owner: Maria) 2) create grafana queue-depth panel and add to hosted-inference dashboard (owner: Alex) 3) add maintenance-window template + silence automation (owner: Eva) 4) annotate routing changes automatically (owner: Alex) 5) run 2h chaos test to validate (owner: SRE rotation). adding to triage board.

Eva Liu: i'm going to push the maintenance template as an RFC PR to infra/alerting. will include example silence TTLs and annotation fields.

Maria Gonzales: i will run the rule backtest and post results here by EOD. if FP rate < 0.5% over last 30 days i will open PR to change.

Samir Patel: handing monitoring watch to Maria. i'm going offline in ~15m. Maria, please escalate if 502s go >1.5% again.

IncidentBot: On-call handoff recorded: Samir Patel -> Maria Gonzales at 12:57 UTC.

Maria Gonzales: taking it. keeping the silence active until we validate threshold updates. will update thread with test results. :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: thanks everyone. closing the page for now. reopen if anything pops back up. :medal_sports:
